name: ImgUpscaler.net
tagline: Enlarge images online with selectable scale and detail modes
description: ImgUpscaler.net is a web-based image-upscaling tool for photographs, product images and illustrations. Its interface offers 2×, 3× and 4× enlargement, with Natural and Extra Detail processing modes. The published free allowance covers two successful images per day up to 8 MP output, while larger supported outputs and additional images use credits. Users should compare the processed result with the original and inspect faces, text and logos, because AI estimates detail rather than guaranteeing recovery of missing information. The website labels its comparison illustrations as demonstrations, not independently verified processing results.
